meta.label: Adaptive Planning credentials
meta.description: Connection settings for the Workday Adaptive Planning API. Shared by every Adaptive connector and exporter in this plugin.

params.name: instance_code
params.label: Instance code
params.description: Adaptive instance code, i.e. the part after '@' in your Adaptive login.

params.name: password
params.label: Password
params.description: Adaptive password for the API user.

params.name: api_version
params.label: API version
params.description: Adaptive Planning XML API version (e.g. v40).

params.name: base_url
params.label: API base URL
params.description: Override only if your tenant uses a regional endpoint.
